**Finding: Compliant** — no redline needed.

Corio (our side) is the licensee/customer paying Commerce One. I reviewed the fee and payment provisions (§4, Exhibit B pricing, revenue sharing fees, Exhibit B payment terms), the term/termination provisions (§11) and the liability cap (§9), and ran targeted searches for "liquidated damages", "penalt", "interest" and "minimum".

- No liquidated damages, penalty or stipulated-damages amount is payable by Corio.
- No early-termination fee, minimum-commitment true-up or accelerated payment on termination; §11 termination is notice/cure based only.
- No late-payment interest or penalty-style charge in the payment terms (§17 / Exhibit B).
- Post-termination payment obligations (§11.3) relate to continued Software use by existing customers, i.e. fees for value actually received, not stipulated damages.
- §9's cap is mutual and limits (rather than pre-fixes) damages; the audit-cost reimbursement in §4.4 is triggered only by a >5% underpayment and is a cost-recovery mechanism, not a penalty.

This meets the preferred position (no liquidated damages or penalties payable by Customer), so I made no changes.
